title: City College missed public spending decisions on $43.35 million in education funds

beats.text: City College spent $10.8 million from a state education account.
California required trustees to decide its use in open session.

visual.kicker: The first audit found no public decision on $10.81 million

beats.text: Auditors found no public decision and no online accounting.

visual.kicker: The first audit found no public decision on $10.81 million

beats.text: The next year the same finding covered $32.5 million.
The auditors tested the expenses and questioned zero dollars.

visual.kicker: The finding returned on $32.54 million the following year

beats.text: The minutes show what changed in November 2021.

visual.kicker: The board approved the following year’s salary plan in open session

beats.text: Trustees unanimously approved an estimated $25.5 million for classroom salaries.
The final schedule reports $39.35 million in instructional salaries and benefits.
It reports zero spending on operations or capital.
The next audit marked the public spending recommendation implemented.

visual.kicker: The subsequent audit closed the finding and shows actual expenditures
